record.question: The conversion of glucose to glycogen is mediated by an enzyme called
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation: Glycogen synthase elongates a glycogen chain by adding glucose units supplied by UDP-glucose. NCBI Bookshelf identifies it as the rate-limiting enzyme of glycogen synthesis. Glycogen phosphorylase instead breaks glycogen down, so it is not the enzyme requested.
